core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nameer is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Pure water; a panther”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nameer corresponds to the Arabic form نَمِير (Arabic root ن م ر (n-m-r); نَمِير (Namīr)). Its core sense is pure water; a panther. Nameer is Arabic نَمِير (Namīr) 'pure water; a panther', from the root ن م ر (n-m-r). The source gloss 'Observer, Watcher' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as namir.

persian.name: نمیر
persian.long_meaning: Nameer (نمیر) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن نمیر، آب پاک است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: नमीर
